notes: The clean network-shape test. p2 and p3 differed in TWO knobs -- fc (320,) + 8 epochs against fc (200,100) + 4 epochs -- so neither settled the two-hidden-layer thread p0 opened, and epochs is the one axis p0 found to move. p1 holds epochs at 8 and takes p3's network, which makes it a single-knob comparison against p2 (the network) and against p3 (the epochs) at the same time.
